explanation: Both bodies have restitution e=1 (perfectly elastic). Small light body collides at high speed (~32 m/s) with massive body and wall bounces. With large dt (~0.0116) and semi-implicit Euler with impulse+positional correction, interpenetration correction / multiple substep collisions inject energy. Energy stays near E0 until ~step 80 (1799J) then jumps to 2886J at step 99, far above allowed 1985J. Setting e=0 removes the spurious energy gain, proving elastic collision handling under large dt is the cause.
